importer_notes: CLI --analyze assumes full8×13 and is unsuitable for a single-direction pilot. Import module and call analyze with rows_count, reference_rows, directions_axis, canvas_size, source_anchors, directions explicitly.
columns packing: logical phases in rows; rows packing: logical phases in columns, selected directions in rows. blocks4x2 uses4 columns and2 rows per phase and requires all8 directions.
Subset sheets require explicit canvas_size (integer64..2048) and nonempty scale_review_note. Canonical direction order E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE.

source_anchors is one integer[x,y] per pose, phase-major then selected-direction order, each inside the cropped pose. Review actual supporting foot/ground contact, especially death; automatic bottommost-pixel anchor can be wrong for weapons/skirts.
all5 mandatory roles must cover all8 directions before import; each role needs at least2 distinct phases; typical established standard is2idle+3walk+3attack+2hit+3death=104 unique poses.
candidate review requires identity_preserved/eight_views/motion_roles/no_clipping true and substantive notes after actual visual review.
IMPORTANT: omitting --apply still writes new assets/SpriteFrames/provenance; --apply additionally binds production profiles. For pilot geometry use analyze only.

Importer rejects visible duplicates including transparent-padding/RGB disguises, crop spill, omitted visible pixels, existing authored/native profile replacement, incomplete role/direction sets. Preserve all existing bytes.

sheets.scale_review_note: Actual measured anatomy/head/torso scale versus approved idle for this direction; review before import.

review.notes: Unapproved schema only; requires remaining directions and roles before import.

production_Main.quality_note: Reports/engine success alone do not prove visual quality. Inspect all8 direction5-role playback, anchor/scale/contact, compare completed exemplar. Keep maps unchanged.

tests_not_run: This audit did not run fullCI/Godot or modify repository files.
